item.title: Critical Drupal installer flaw under active attack (CVE-2026-132165)
item.description: Attackers have been exploiting CVE-2026-132165, a flaw that lets them take over unpatched Drupal sites without logging in, since at least November 19, the Drupal Security Team has warned. Drupal is a free and open-source web content management system used by government agencies, universities, media outlets and large enterprises.
